title: Product
description: One catalog entry: catalog/<category>/<slug>.yml. Says what the product is, how its versions compare and where its advisories come from.

slug.description: Must equal the file name without .yml.

category.description: Must equal the folder the file sits in.

images.description: Official container images and the grammar of their tags, used by the generator and optional discovery. Empty when the product is not usually run from an image.

sources.description: Where advisories for this product are found, ordered by trust (first is most trusted).

strategy.description: vendor-ranges: per-branch affected and fixed versions from the vendor or its CNA. package-ranges: ranges of a language package (OSV, GHSA). distro-notice: match on the distro release, not a version. release-only: no usable advisory data, new releases only.

curated.description: True when reviewed self-hoster notes are written for this product.

data_notes.description: Known quirks of this product's advisory data, for whoever maintains ingest.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Where supported release branches and EOL dates come from.

ref.description: Fully qualified repository, registry included, no tag.

tag_pattern.description: Regular expression a version tag matches, with a named group version. Must work in both ECMAScript and Go RE2 (no lookarounds).

cveCnaSource.title: CveCnaSource
cveCnaSource.description: cvelistV5 records whose assigner and affected product match.

products.description: containers.cna.affected[].product values that belong to this product. ["*"] takes every product of the vendor, for a CNA that names each package separately (Go: net/http, crypto/x509); it needs vendor.

vendor.description: containers.cna.affected[].vendor, when the assigner publishes for several vendors.

ghsaRepoSource.title: GhsaRepoSource
ghsaRepoSource.description: Security advisories published on a GitHub repository.

packages.description: Package names of the advisory entries that version this product (vulnerabilities[].package.name, compared without case and surrounding spaces), for repositories whose advisories also list apps, plugins or installers. When set, only these entries count, and an advisory naming none of them is not about this product. An empty string matches an entry without a name.

ghsaPackageSource.title: GhsaPackageSource
ghsaPackageSource.description: GitHub Advisory Database entries for one package, as GHSA names its ecosystem and package.

osvSource.title: OsvSource
osvSource.description: OSV records for one package in one OSV ecosystem.

vendorPageSource.title: VendorPageSource
vendorPageSource.description: A human-readable vendor page: cross-check and a trigger to write a note, never parsed as the primary record.

vendorFeedSource.title: VendorFeedSource
vendorFeedSource.description: A vendor RSS or Atom feed of security announcements.
